name: Danganronpa: Desperate Hope
source:
A girl named Yuma awakens in a strange place, finding herself in an unexpected situation... She is confronted by lots of obstacles that you'll have to help her overcome.

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/danganronpadesperatehope/3]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫尤玛的女孩在一个陌生的地方醒来，发现自己陷入了意想不到的境地……她面临着许多障碍，你必须帮助她克服这些障碍。

[译自[url=https://t.me/danganronpadesperatehope/3]Telegram[/url]]
